verdict.rationale: A state tax and wage-reporting agency could publish file-format specs, XML schemas or a data dictionary for bulk wage filing, so this axis applies. The evidence shows only web-portal filing through EAMS/SAW, PDF and paper forms, and probes that returned 404 at every OpenAPI candidate path. No machine-readable specification is documented.

support.subject: As a developer, a machine-readable specification for the service's machine channel is published — an OpenAPI spec, XML schemas, or a data dictionary
